parts.text: As a fleet technician, I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order. My hands-on tasks include adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, setting up charging pads at our sites, taking drones out of service for repairs and putting them back, and sending drones to charge. Regulators can also ask us to show how our drones have been looked after. I know nothing about software and cannot say what this new service should handle for me.
